Dragged up, or Expand: full height, the rows scroll.

motion

Open: the pane slides in from its edge and fades, slower, emphasized. Close: fast, ease-in. Expand: the height grows in slow, standard while the rows fade in one after another. Phone: the sheet rises, slow, emphasized.
